test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate active form of the given sentence.**

Not much damage to the life and property was caused by the cyclone in July this year at the Andhra coast.

options.text: The Andhra coast did not cause much damage to the life and property in July this year at the cyclone.
The cyclone could not cause much damage to the life and property in July this year at the.
The cyclone did not cause much damage to the life and property in July this year at the Andhra coast.
The cyclone has not caused much damage to the life and property in July this year at the Andhra coast.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The cyclone did not cause much damage to the life and property in July this year at the Andhra coast.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of the passive voice of the simple past tense.
 
• Simple past tense: It is defined as an action started in past, finished in past, and has no relation to the present.
 
• Structure:
 
 
• (Active voice) Subject+ the second form of verb+ object
 
• (Passive voice) Object+ was/were+ the third form of verb.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• She wrote a letter. (Active voice)
 
 
• Here, the subject is 'she', the object is 'letter' and the main verb is 'wrote' which is the second form of the verb 'write'. To convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject and object will change their places and will be connected with a linking verb followed by the third form of the main verb.
 
 
 
• A letter was written by her. (Passive voice)
 
 
 
• Thus, in the above-given sentence, the object of the sentence i.e. **'Not much damage to the life and property' **will exchange its place with the subject of the sentence i.e. **'the cyclone'**, and will be connected with the linking verb and the third form of the main verb. Since the sentence is following the negative structure it will be converted as follows:
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• Nothing about it was known to her. (Passive voice)
 
• She did not know anything about it. (Active voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**

 

Correct sentence:__ *The cyclone did not cause much damage to the life and property in July this year at the Andhra coast.*
